eligibility_criteria: Must be located within 200km of a UFA location
Project must be a capital project (physical assets only — buildings, facilities, equipment)
Project must enrich education, recreation or culture in an agricultural community
Project must be available and accessible for community use
Project must be completed within 2 years of receiving the grant
exclusions: CRITICAL: Operating costs and salaries not eligible — capital projects only
Organizations that do not inclusively benefit community members
Projects duplicative of existing services in the community
Communities awarded significant UFA funding in the previous 5 years may be excluded
